paite: Kum sagih achin kum in ngaihdamna na bawl ding uh ahi.
heading: Akum Sagihna / (Lev 25.1-7)
english: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

paite: Ngaihdamdan ding hichibang ahi: Leiba neimi peuhmah in a-invengte ana leitawisak angaihdam ding ahi. A-invengte leng, a-u anau leng asik teitei ding ahi kei; TOUPA khahkhiak chih ahih ziak in.
english: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because Yahweh’s release has been proclaimed.

paite: Namdangmi ahihleh na sik teitei thei ding uh. Himahleh nou a bangpeuh na unaute un ana zat uh na ngaihdam ding uh ahi.
english: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

paite: Mizawng himhim na om ding uh ahi kei; TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia nou ahon piak gam ah TOUPA'N lah hon vualzawl ngei ding ahi ngal a.
english: However there will be no poor with you (for Yahweh will surely bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)

paite: Hiai thupiak tuni a ka thupiak tengteng zui dia TOUPA na Pathian uh phatuamngaitak a na zuih peuhmah uleh;
english: if only you diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon chiam bang in hon vualzawl ding a, nam tampi na leitawisak ding uh. Nam tampi tung ah vai na hawm ding ua, nou tung ah bel amau vai ahawm kei ding uhi.
english: For Yahweh your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

paite: TOUPA'N ahon gam piak na tenna ua na unaute uh lak a mizawng a-om uleh na unau gentheite lak ah na lungsim khauhsak kei unla, sumchil sam kei un.
english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

paite: Atung uah na thilphal ngeingei ding ua, ataksap awng hukna khop na leitawisak ding uh ahi.
english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

paite: "Ngaihdam kum, akum sagihna ahong tung dekta, chi in na unau zawngte mudah a bangmah pe nuam lou in na lungtang uah dikloutak a ngaihtuahna om lou ding in pilvang un," Huchi lou in zaw, amau na tungtang thu uah TOUPA asam ding ua, nou a ding in khelhna ahi kha ding.
english: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.

paite: Na piak ngeingei ding uh ahi. Na piak chiang un leng na lungtang uh anuam moh ding ahi kei. Huchibang thil ziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un na thilhih tengteng uah leh na khut ngakna peuh uh ahon vualzawl ding hi.
english: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

paite: Huai gam ah lah mizawngte om louh lai om lou ding ahi ngal a. Huaiziak in na gam ua na unaute uh tung ah, tasamte tung ah, na mizawngte uh tung ah, na thilphal ngeingei ding uh ahi, chih ka hon thupiak ahi.
english: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

paite: Na unau uh, Hebru pa hiam, Hebru nu hiam, na kiang ua azuak ua, kum guk nangmah nna asepleh akum sagih kum in na khah ding uh ahi.
heading: Sikhate Kepdan Ding / (Eks 21.1-11)
english: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

paite: Na khah chiang un khutvuak in na pawtsak ding uh ahi kei.
english: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

paite: Na belamhon ua kipan, na phual ua kipan, na uain sukna khuk ua kipan itloutak in na pe ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawl dan bang zel in na pe ding uhi.
english: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

paite: Aigupta gam ah sikha na hita ua, TOUPA na Pathian un hon tan chih na theigige ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in ahi, tua hiai thu ka hon piak.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, noute leh na inkuan uh angaih ziak uleh, na kihoutheih ziak ua, "K'on pawtsan kei ding," achih bikbek aleh;
english: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

paite: sikzum na la ding ua, kongkhak ah abil na vut pailet ding ua, huchi in tangtawn in na sikha uh ahi ding. Na sikhanu uh leng huchi mah bang in na hih ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

paite: Pawtsak thil haksa bang in na ngaihtuah ding uh ahi kei. Kiloh sep zahnih sem in kum guk nang nna ahon sepsak khinta ngal a. TOUPA na Pathian un na thilhih peuh uah hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God will bless you in all that you do.

paite: Na ganhonte uh, na belamhonte uh lak a apa, piang masapente TOUPA na Pathian uh a tuam in na pe ding uhi. Na ganhon uh apiang masapen nasem ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei. Na belamhonte uh lak a piang masapen mul na met ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Piang Masa Bawng Leh Belam
english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kum teng in TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah nou leh na inkuante uh toh na ne ding uh ahi.
english: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.

paite: Gensiat kai, akhe bai hiam, amit taw hiam, gensiatna om peuhmah TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a kithoihna ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei.
english: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.

paite: Na omna huangsung ah na ne ding uh ahi. Asiangloute leh asiangte'n sangai leh sakhi leng ane thei ding uh.
english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

paite: Asisan kia na ne ding uh ahi kei. Tui bang in lei ah na sungbua mai ding uh ahi.
english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
